notes: §2002:13.16.55.2 SR14: at most one CONTROL HEADING and one CONTROL FOOTING for each control data item or FINAL. The census counts a group per ControlLevel, so two footings of T-C(1, 2) and T-C(2, 3) are two levels and legal; the golden has one footing for each of the three levels (kb/Work PB5602).
